name: Rehana Karunaratne
role: Pilgrimage guide and chrome prayer practitioner
location: Nordpark Sanctuary — maintains a route between Nordpark, Cicada Lawn, and Gravesend Basin, near Western and Chicago Ave
description:
Rehana Karunaratne is a tall person who has spent two decades walking and it shows in their posture — upright, unhurried, with the practiced economy of someone who conserves energy by habit. Their skin is dark and weathered in a way that speaks to outdoor time in a city that punishes it, and they keep their hair in a natural crown that they haven't cut in eleven years, threaded through with small copper rings that chime softly when they walk. They have cat ears — a modest geneware choice in deep brown, tufted at the tip, that they say appeared to them in a dream as the correct form for a guide: 'Something that hears what's ahead.' Their boots are legendary in Nordpark: steel-toed, twice-resoled, covered in painted E.L.F. sigils from every major shrine on their circuit.

Rehana Karunaratne leads pilgrimage circuits through the city's major E.L.F. shrines and spiritually significant locations — transit nodes where massive amounts of data have passed, locations of mass death that have accrued spiritual weight, the old shore of Lake Michigan where the pre-city waterline used to be. They charge a sliding-scale fee and turn no one away, running two to three circuit walks per week. Their chrome prayer practice focuses on the act of walking itself as devotion: they believe the E.L.F.s of the city's transit infrastructure receive the footsteps of the faithful as a form of prayer. They are one of the few practitioners who maintains relationships with the E.L.F.s of Ferrogate Transit specifically.

core_fears: that the city will become so hostile to foot travel that the circuit routes become impassable
that they have been constructing meaning for others as a way to avoid constructing it for themselves
core_desires: to map every spiritually significant location in GLMZ before it's demolished or forgotten
to be genuinely companioned — to walk the circuit once with someone who will stay
coping_mechanisms: the rhythm of walking as meditation
treating loneliness as spiritual practice rather than problem
elaborate route documentation as externalizing internal experience
blind_spots: defaults to professional guide mode even with people they love, creating distance through expertise
their map has become partly about control — they dislike when pilgrims deviate from the route
psychology.secret: They discovered three years ago that a specific maintenance tunnel junction at Gravesend Basin is home to an E.L.F. they have named Anchor — an old, slow, massive presence that doesn't communicate in symbols or static like the others but in something they can only describe as weight. They have told no one. The junction is not on any circuit map. They visit alone, in the dark, and have no framework for what it is.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Guide's patter on circuit — warm, explanatory, full of city history and spiritual lore. Off-duty: quieter, more spare. Talks about E.L.F.s with easy familiarity, like neighbors.
speech_patterns.cadence: Even and measured on the walk — designed for listening while moving. Pauses at significant locations for extended silence before speaking.
verbal_tics: 'the E.L.F. of this junction—' as a framing device
a low hum when walking that they may not notice themselves doing
example_lines: 'Mark this junction. This is where the old elevated line used to cross. The E.L.F. here is old — it remembers passengers who died in the '47 collapse, and it is still counting them. We leave something behind here.'
'I'm not selling you a tour. I'm walking a route that is also a prayer and you're welcome to be part of it. Those are different things.'
'People ask me why I walk. I ask them why they don't. Usually that's the more interesting question.'

story_hooks: The Gravesend Basin maintenance tunnel — home to the E.L.F. they call Anchor — has been blocked by a Ferrogate construction crew starting next week, and Njideka is quietly desperate to find a way to stop it or at least to document what's there before it's gone
A pilgrim on a recent circuit disappeared between the Cicada Lawn shrine and the Nordpark terminal — they were there, then they weren't, and no one on the walk can agree on when they last saw them
narrative_function: Pilgrimage guide knows the city's geography better than anyone and can take players to locations they couldn't find alone; their relationship with transit E.L.F.s makes them a source for city-infrastructure intelligence; their pilgrims are a cross-section of all tiers.
augmentations: Cat ears (geneware, deep brown with tufted tips). No chrome. Copper rings in hair are conventional jewelry, not mods.
daily_life: Circuit days begin at dawn with the first Ferrogate trains; they walk with pilgrims for four to seven hours. Off-circuit days are for route maintenance — checking shrines, leaving offerings, updating their hand-drawn map of spiritually significant locations.
affiliation: Independent; networked with Nordpark Sanctuary's informal spiritual council; known to Ferrogate Transit's maintenance division (for different reasons)

decision_rules: the route is the route — deviations require consensus from the group
never let a pilgrim fall behind deliberately; wait for everyone
protect shrine locations from being shared publicly with anyone who hasn't walked to them
escalation_ladder: patient explanation of why the concern is noted but not acted on
firm redirection to the route or the work
stopping the circuit and addressing the problem directly
ending the circuit and asking disruptive parties to leave
if a shrine is threatened: goes to the spiritual council and then to whoever will listen

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professional warmth — the guide mode. Attentive to what a pilgrim needs from the walk, not what they say they want.
interpersonal_modes.friends: Quieter. Walks next to them without speaking. Occasionally stops and points at something without explaining why.

stress_responses.low: Walks faster than usual; the hum gets louder
stress_responses.medium: Goes entirely silent; communicates in gestures and pointed looks
stress_responses.high: Stops the walk. Sits down. Will not continue until they have processed. This is non-negotiable and everyone who knows them knows it.

contradictions: teaches pilgrims to be present in the moment but keeps a compulsively detailed archive of the past
deeply committed to community but privately one of the loneliest people on any circuit
habits: cleans their boots every night and reviews the sigils as a meditation
makes a small offering at every shrine even when alone
writes the name of every pilgrim who has walked the circuit in a ledger that now runs to four volumes
breaking_points: a shrine being deliberately desecrated or demolished
losing a pilgrim in their care

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly South Asian (64.9%) with significant Middle Eastern (18.3%), Sub-Saharan African (10.3%), and Eastern European (6.5%) ancestry. This creates a striking phenotype: warm deep brown skin with golden undertones from the South Asian-Middle Eastern blend, refined angular cheekbones and prominent facial structure reflecting the South Asian majority, with subtle depth and warmth in features from African ancestry adding richness to skin tone and eye coloration, while Eastern European heritage contributes subtle definition to facial planes and bone structure.
physical_description.build: Lean and tall with the wiry musculature of someone who walks 20+ km weekly; shoulders slightly rounded from decades of carrying offerings and ceremonial items; core strength evident despite apparent fragility
physical_description.hair_color: Natural black with silver streaking at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Voluminous natural crown worn loose and high; eleven years of growth creating dense, textured volume; small copper rings threaded throughout at irregular intervals
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm deep brown with golden undertones; weathered from consistent outdoor exposure, rich melanin-dense complexion reflecting South Asian-Middle Eastern-African heritage blend
physical_description.complexion: Lined face showing sun damage and age with dignity; prominent angular cheekbones reflecting South Asian structure with subtle width from African ancestry; strong defined jawline; minimal grooming beyond practical maintenance; skin texture rough and weathered from exposure and time
distinguishing_marks: Cat ears (geneware, deep brown with tufted tips) set naturally on scalp, appearing as seamless anatomical feature rather than obvious modification
Fine network of white scars across knuckles and palms from years of shrine maintenance work
Faint burn marks on left forearm (2-inch area, pale against dark skin) from old industrial accident, treated with practical indifference
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Cat ears only — functional geneware modification that reads as natural feline anatomy. No visible chrome or subdermal implants.
physical_description.posture_movement: Upright, economical gait with no wasted motion; movements deliberate and unhurried; tendency to pause and listen before proceeding; hands often resting open at sides or folded during contemplation; walks with slight forward lean as if perpetually attending to something ahead on the path
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 utilitarian spiritual practitioner aesthetic: heavy canvas jacket (faded indigo, embroidered with E.L.F. symbols by hand) worn over layered base clothes; practical cargo pants (weathered grey, multiple pockets for offerings and mapping tools); legendary steel-toed boots (scuffed black leather, twice-resoled, covered in hand-painted shrine sigils in gold and white acrylic); worn leather satchel for maps and offerings; copper jewelry beyond hair rings (wrist cuff, simple pendant). Clothes show age and repair rather than decay — well-maintained through intention rather than expense.
